verdict.rationale: Apple's spec page documents on-chip hardware acceleration for H.264, HEVC, ProRes and ProRes RAW, which covers the HEVC and ProRes-class core of the story. AV1, which the story names explicitly, is not mentioned anywhere in the pack. The spec line also does not say which codecs are accelerated for encode versus decode. Missing for 10: any evidence of AV1 hardware encode/decode, an explicit encode-versus-decode breakdown per codec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of media-engine performance for editing or streaming.
